recordwise_owner_collar_E_Tr.canonical_Borel_selection: k(omega)=min{k>=0:2^(-k)<=min(1,d(omega))} and ell(omega)=2^(-(k(omega)+1))<d(omega); measurable integer minima on the standard-Borel base make ell Borel

signed_hit_miss_pairing_resolvent.coupling_kernel: in every fixed marked standard-Borel fiber define canonically pi_p=0 when m_p=0 and pi_p=(mu_p^+ tensor mu_p^-)/m_p when m_p>0; this normalized-product formula has marginals mu_p^+,mu_p^-, total mass m_p, and is a Borel kernel without any measurable-choice theorem
signed_hit_miss_pairing_resolvent.logical_scope: a signed F13/F17/MT_DQ route only; constant cancellation alone gives no distance decay and cannot close positive F10 or cemetery mass

signed_hit_miss_pairing_resolvent.physical_flux_distance_sufficient_condit: if pi_p is supported on d(y+,y-)<=A*delta_pair^p, then the Round44 mass bound gives d_p(pi_p)<=A*(8064/5)*delta_pair^p
signed_hit_miss_pairing_resolvent.physical_flux_typing: the coefficient is the actual physical sigma_e flux law frozen in Round44; 2^B is only a positive occurrence-rank envelope and is not identified with sigma_e
signed_hit_miss_pairing_resolvent.physical_signed_pair: write the physical signed source flux as lambda_p=lambda_p^+-lambda_p^- from the Jordan decomposition of sigma_e; with the immutable hit and miss kernels H_p,M_p set mu_p^+=H_p*lambda_p^+ + M_p*lambda_p^- and mu_p^-=M_p*lambda_p^+ + H_p*lambda_p^-; then J_p=mu_p^+-mu_p^- and both positive marginals have equal mass m_p=abs(lambda_p)(source)
signed_hit_miss_pairing_resolvent.rank_envelope_conditional: alternatively, if only m_p<=C_sigma*2^B and support(pi_p) lies in d<=A*2^(-B)*delta_pair^p, then d_p<=A*C_sigma*delta_pair^p; this is an envelope hypothesis, never the equality sigma_e=2^B
signed_hit_miss_pairing_resolvent.why_q_star_is_bypassed: the estimate pairs the signed images before absolute values; it is not Holder interpolation of the positive 2^B trace charge
